Ciudad Universitaria — Madrid, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The Complutense University campus area is a well-documented recurring site of large student 'macrobotellones' (mass open-air drinking gatherings), with one post-exam event leaving four municipal police officers injured and three people requiring treatment for alcohol poisoning. These are night-time phenomena tied to the student calendar; daytime campus activity shows no comparable pattern of disorder. Sources checked: El Independiente, Sept 2021; El Plural; Telemadrid, Apr 2022; ElDiario.es/Somos Madrid (EVAU botellon).

This rating comes from a structured local-source assessment. This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Ciudad Universitaria safe?

Wandroz currently rates Ciudad Universitaria in Madrid as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Ciudad Universitaria safe at night?

At night, Ciudad Universitaria is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Madrid. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Ciudad Universitaria a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Ciudad Universitaria's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for Ciudad Universitaria?

Not an official government crime feed — Ciudad Universitaria's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used).
